items.a: Two things. A 21-video course that teaches you how to onboard a home client properly, and 28 ready templates that do the work for you, from the first meeting right up to a signed brief.

items.q: I have never done this before. Will I understand it?
items.a: Yes. The course assumes you know nothing about onboarding, because most designers were never taught it. It starts from what onboarding even means, and walks you through every step in the order you will actually use it. If you have done zero projects, this is the cleanest way to start. If you have done a hundred, it fixes the leak you have been living with.

items.q: My clients will never sit through so many questions.
items.a: That is the most common worry and the course answers it head on. Module 4 opens with six real situations where a client pushes back, with the exact words to say in each one, and then the system for the client who simply goes quiet on you. Also, no client ever sits through all of it in one go. One meeting before the yes. Few sittings after it. The rest goes out on WhatsApp in small pieces, to the person who actually owns that room, and each piece takes them a few minutes.

items.q: Do I need to buy any software?
items.a: No. The questionnaires can be run on Google Forms or Notion forms, which is free, and everything goes to your client on WhatsApp. A couple of the working templates sit in Notion, and Notion's free plan covers it. There is nothing to buy on top of this.

items.q: Will it work for a small 2BHK?
items.a: Yes. 1BHK, 3BHK or bungalow, metro or small town, joint family or nuclear. You only run the rooms that are in your scope.

Straight after payment. You are taken to your dashboard with everything inside it, and you also get an order confirmation email with your links within 5 to 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it. Log in with the email or phone number you paid with and start.

items.q: What is the difference between the two plans?
items.a:
"Templates Only" gives you all 28 templates plus the written how-to guidance inside each one.

"Complete" gives you all of that, plus the 21-video course that shows you how to actually run it, plus the three bonuses, plus every future update free. The difference is simple. The templates tell you what to ask. The course tells you how to ask it, in what order, what to do when the client pushes back, and how to turn everything they said into your design.

items.q: Is this a one time payment?
items.a: Yes. One payment, that is it. Yours forever.
Yes. 100% money back. Use it on your next project, and if it's not for you, write to support@eazydezyn.com and we will refund you.

Yes. The price goes up every time new lessons and updates are added. Everyone who buys now gets every future update free, forever. So the earlier you buy, the less you pay and the more you end up with.

items.q: Why not just use a free questionnaire from the internet?
items.a: Because a free questionnaire is a list somebody generated from AI, which doesn't know shit about running an Interior design business. You do not know who wrote it, whether they have ever run a project in India, or why any question is on the list. So you send it, they don't even fill it, and you still do not have what your design needs, because the questions that matter are not the obvious ones. What I'm giving you is not a list of questions, it is the whole process, built and run on 110+ real projects, with the course that makes it work and a signed brief at the end that protects you. I know exactly what I have made and I am very confident about what it does for you. If it does not do it, you get your money back. As simple as that.

items.q: I already bought your old Residential Onboarding template. What about me?
items.a: Well then you might want to check your emails, your spam folders, and promotion folders once, so that you can find our updated access link which includes everything that's mentioned here. If for any reason it didn't reach you, email support@eazydezyn.com and we will sort you out.
Write to support@eazydezyn.com and we will answer you within 24 working hours.
